fact: AGT says it is building its own in-house AI system trained on internally supplied data, with machine-learning tests since 2024.

Angola Telecom and the Digital Africa Development Agency announced an investment programme, backed in its first phase by the Agence Francaise de Developpement, for an AI factory to be hosted in Angola Telecom data centres, with a proof of concept of Mistral AI models launched at ANGOTIC 2025 in Luanda on 12-14 June 2025.
